topics.name: Cartpole Dynamics
topics.description: Explores the dynamics and control strategies for the cartpole problem.

sub_topics.name: Swingup Cartpole
sub_topics.description: Techniques for swinging the cartpole to an upright position.

sub_topics.name: Balance Cartpole
sub_topics.description: Methods for maintaining the cartpole in a balanced state.

sub_topics.name: Sparse Cartpole
sub_topics.description: Approaches using sparse representations for cartpole control.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of physics and introductory control theory.
common_misconceptions: The cartpole is stable when upright
Only linear control methods are effective

topics.name: Neural Computation
topics.description: Focuses on the principles and applications of neural networks.

sub_topics.name: Neural Information
sub_topics.description: Study of information processing in neural networks.

sub_topics.name: Neural Network Models
sub_topics.description: Different architectures and components of neural networks.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus, familiarity with programming concepts.
common_misconceptions: Neural networks can learn without data
More layers always mean better performance

topics.name: Imagination and Planning
topics.description: Investigates the role of imagination in planning and decision-making.

sub_topics.name: Universal Planning Networks
sub_topics.description: Frameworks for planning using neural networks.

sub_topics.name: Imagination Horizon
sub_topics.description: Concepts related to the foresight in planning.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of cognitive psychology and decision-making processes.
common_misconceptions: Imagination is purely creative and not analytical.
Planning does not require emotional considerations.

topics.name: Reconstruction Techniques
topics.description: Methods for reconstructing data and predictions in machine learning.

sub_topics.name: Image Reconstruction
sub_topics.description: Techniques for reconstructing images from data.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and data structures.
common_misconceptions: Reconstruction is only for missing data
All reconstruction techniques are the same

topics.name: Latent Dynamics Models
topics.description: Models that capture the latent dynamics of systems.

sub_topics.name: For Latent Dynamics Models
sub_topics.description: Techniques and frameworks for latent dynamics.

sub_topics.name: Dreamer Models
sub_topics.description: Specific models for dreaming and planning in latent spaces.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning, linear algebra, and probability theory.
common_misconceptions: Latent dynamics models are only for time series data.
They cannot be used for non-linear systems.

topics.name: Hopper Dynamics
topics.description: Focuses on the dynamics and control strategies for the hopper problem.

sub_topics.name: Hopper Stand
sub_topics.description: Techniques for maintaining the hopper in a standing position.

sub_topics.name: Hopper Hop
sub_topics.description: Methods for controlling the hopping motion of the hopper.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of dynamics and control systems, familiarity with linear algebra and differential equations.
common_misconceptions: Hopper dynamics only involves static analysis
Control strategies are universally applicable without modification

topics.name: Activation Functions
topics.description: Functions that determine the output of neural network nodes.

sub_topics.name: Common Activation Functions
sub_topics.description: Overview of widely used activation functions in neural networks.

sub_topics.name: Custom Activation Functions
sub_topics.description: Development of specialized activation functions for specific tasks.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of neural networks and calculus.
common_misconceptions: Activation functions are only used in the output layer.

topics.name: Loss Functions
topics.description: Functions used to measure the difference between predicted and actual outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Common Loss Functions
sub_topics.description: Overview of frequently used loss functions in machine learning.

sub_topics.name: Custom Loss Functions
sub_topics.description: Designing loss functions tailored to specific applications.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Loss functions only apply to regression problems.
Lower loss always means better model performance.

topics.name: Backpropagation
topics.description: The algorithm used for training neural networks through gradient descent.

sub_topics.name: Training Neural Networks
sub_topics.description: Process of training neural networks using backpropagation.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of calculus, linear algebra, and neural networks.
common_misconceptions: Backpropagation is the same as training a neural network.
